race.comment: DEER POWER (3) was twice an impressive triallist prior to being beaten in both of his career starts to date, and on each occasion he has not had all the favours. He has copped another tough gate here, but a change of luck would make him hard to beat. Follow your money. ALPINEFURTHER (1) makes his debut, and he has been showing talent at the trials. He maps to track the speed from a handy gate, and he is expected to make an immediate impact. Use the market as the best guide. DREAM RIOT (4) is on debut, and he won his only public trial to date very easily. A good draw helps, and he can figure in the finish. JAGGERS EDGE (5) won his latest trial, which was his first this season, and he will be ready to rumble on debut. SPIRIT OF COCO (9) finished less than 2 lengths from the winner as the favourite on debut here a fortnight ago. He will naturally improve, and is good enough to have a say in the finish here. Stick with him.
